author: Eric Skovan
text:
You cannot have more that one active sensor. When you scan a new one, the old one becomes no longer scannable.

So don't do it until it ends.

author: Gail Menne Bowman
text: You have to remove the old sensor from your arm or wait for the old one to stop on its own then scan the new one. It will take 60 minutes for the new one to start recording.
